result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 3, Article 9, Division 1) covering the city minimum wage and earned sick leave provisions, sections 39.0106-39.0115, mislabeled under a URL about algorithmic rent-price fixing.
result.notes: This part contains only employment provisions (earned sick leave, minimum wage, notice/posting, employer records, retaliation, remedies, enforcement). None of it concerns rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting, so no in-scope rules were extracted. The URL suggests a section on prohibition of algorithmic rent-setting devices (San Diego zoning/rent price-fixing division), but that text does not appear in this part.
